name: fastarm-desk_tempho_1995
cmd: set -e; C={cache}/desk_tempho_1995; O={out}; P={python}; $P research/exp/fast_arm.py --cache $C --out $O/A0 --tag A0_iso_raw_r24; $P research/exp/fast_arm.py --cache $C --out $O/A1 --features ema --tag A1_iso_ema_r24; $P research/exp/fast_arm.py --cache $C --out $O/A2 --rank 64 --tag A2_iso_raw_r64; $P research/exp/fast_arm.py --cache $C --out $O/A3 --kernel split --tag A3_split_raw_r24; $P research/exp/fast_arm.py --cache $C --out $O/A4 --time-basis 4 --tag A4_iso_raw_r24_tb4; $P research/exp/fast_arm.py --cache $C --out $O/A5 --lag-hl 10 --tag A5_iso_raw_r24_lag10
summarize: for a in A0 A1 A2 A3 A4 A5; do {python} research/exp/fast_arm.py --summarize {out}/$a; done
